guidelines.detail: documentation rule COL-03 not applied (The validator reports a message flow whose endpoints are in the same pool, while the description includes the payment activity in the process. COL-03 already states to use sequence flows within one participant process and message flows between participants, so this guideline repeats it.)

refines FID-01 (The description states that the mechanic enters information about the repair outcome, while the generated model substitutes a physical repair task for the reference information-entry activity. This refines FID-01 by specifying how to preserve a stated recording activity.)

same as LRN-027 (The description says that the participant receives status updates, while the generated label reverses this to sending them. This supports preserving the stated action and perspective, as LRN-027 already advises.)

refines FID-02 (The description makes payment conditional on the repair being done, while the validator identifies a detached start event for payment. This supports modeling payment as a continuation of the ongoing flow. FID-02 requires preserving described dependencies; this guideline specifies how to model that dependency. The separate-start guidance in PROC-04 does not apply because the description does not gi)

refines ACT-07 (The reference models a decision after the update activity, with a repeat path and a path to payment. The generated start event and task do not provide that decision structure. ACT-07 calls for a gateway when the description requires a decision; this guideline specifies how to model a decision that may remain unmet during a wait.)

same as LRN-027 (The description says the process participant receives status updates, while the generated label changes this to sending them. LRN-027 already captures preserving the stated action’s direction. The documented guideline FID-03 supports faithful labels generally, but does not state this direction-specific point.)

same as LRN-072 (The description makes payment available when the repair is done, and records S9 describes the repair-success milestone. The validator records show the payment start event detached from the main flow; the learned guideline LRN-072 already covers this situation.)

same as LRN-073 (The description supports a condition controlling whether payment can proceed while updates occur during the wait. The missing gateway and flows, plus the generated start event, show this condition was represented differently. This matches learned guideline LRN-073; the documented event-based gateway guideline applies to first-occurring events and does not contradict this condition-checking pattern)

same as LRN-027 (The generated label changes receiving status updates into sending them, while other label differences substitute or omit described action details. The proposed guidance is essentially covered by learned guideline LRN-027.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: Use sequence flows inside one participant process and message flows between different participants. Never use sequence flow across pools.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description places an activity within a participant’s process rather than describing communication with another participant

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a participant records information about a real-world situation or its outcome: Model the information-recording work as an activity; do not substitute the underlying physical-world activity for it.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a participant records information about a real-world situation or its outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description explicitly states an action performed by a participant, and a related receipt or outcome could be mistaken for that action: Label the BPMN activity with the stated action and preserve its direction; do not replace it with the corresponding action from another participant’s perspective.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity and identifies who performs it or who receives it.

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an action becomes available only after a milestone in an ongoing process: Model the action in the existing process flow, connected to the relevant milestone by sequence flow, rather than as an independent start event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that an action becomes available only after a milestone in an ongoing process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says a later action must wait until a condition is met, while the process may continue waiting or providing updates before that happens: Model the condition with a decision gateway: loop back to the waiting or update activity while it is unmet, and proceed to the later action when it is met. Do not represent the condition becoming true as a separate start event or as an activity in place of the decision.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says a later action must wait until a condition is met, while the process may continue waiting or providing updates before that happens
